mechanism_narrative: A persistent increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for two consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary stance, raising discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the rank IC falls below 0.05 in a 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A year-over-year decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by GDPC1) exceeding 2% coincident with a housing starts (HOUST) drop of more than 10% in the prior quarter signals weakening aggregate demand, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 YoY change < -2% AND HOUST QoQ change < -10%
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate in at least one NBER-defined recession.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly unemployment rate below 4% for three consecutive months signals a tight labor market, which increases wage pressures and input costs, ultimately producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to margin compression.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism does not trigger during any period of actual wage inflation acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) of more than 0.5% for four consecutive months signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO monthly change < -0.5% for 4 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate during a documented manufacturing recession.

mechanism_narrative: A coordinated decline in both the federal funds rate and the 10-year Treasury yield (proxied by RSAFS, assuming RSAFS reflects long-term yields in this context) below their respective 5-year averages signals a broad decline in risk-free rates, which shifts equity discount rates lower and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the rank IC is below 0.04 in a 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in real personal income (proxied by PAYEMS growth) above 0.5% coincident with a consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) rise below 2% for three consecutive months signals improving real purchasing power without inflationary pressure, which supports consumer spending and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.5% AND CPIAUCSL monthly change < 2% for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate during a period of actual GDP growth acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly payroll employment growth (PAYEMS) acceleration above 0.4% for two consecutive months signals robust labor market expansion, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS monthly change > 0.4% for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism does not activate during a period of confirmed GDP growth acceleration.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 900,000 units for four consecutive months signals a prolonged housing downturn, which reduces construction-related economic activity and drags on equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days regardless of regime.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of triggered episodes, or the mechanism fails to activate during a documented housing market contraction.
